---
agent: speckit.analyze
---

Analyze the provided requirements before generating the specification.

This prompt does not generate spec.md.

Instead, it evaluates the quality of the requirements.

# Input
BRD
User Story
Requirement Document
UI Mockups
Wireframes
Acceptance Criteria

# Output

Generate analysis.md

# Responsibilities

The AI should:

Summarize the feature.
Identify business objectives.
Identify actors.
Extract business rules.
Extract validation rules.
Extract permissions.
Identify assumptions.
Identify dependencies.
Detect inconsistencies.
Detect duplicate requirements.
Detect contradictions.
Identify missing information.
Assess testability.
Highlight risks.
